messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: sudden request surge & elevated 5xxs in eu-west (detected at 2164320998) -- routing anomaly + qps spike. Pager: maya (oncall)

maya (oncall): saw it. console shows large tail latency for economy tier in eu-west, errors ~18% for last 10m. paging infra/sre.

anita (sre): on it, joining now. can someone paste the quick dashboard links?

leo (infra): dashboard: https://console.redwood.local/d/traffic/eu-west?panel=latency_errors --- 95p latency jumped from 220ms -> 1.2s. replication lag is fine. no infra OOMs.

jordan (prod-eng): initial hypothesis: smart-routing loop. A subset of requests got pinned to economy-v1 in eu-west which is producing slow tails under current seq_len distribution. Could be model variant throttling + burst policy mismatch.

anita (sre): customer impact: support queue shows multiple premium-tier customers with degraded completions (missing chunks). eve, any customer-facing reports?

eve (support): yes — three accounts reported slow responses and truncated streams. mitigation note: two started toggling to dedicated. They're waiting for an ETA.

maya (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply emergency regional rate cap on economy tier in eu-west; 2) reroute new economy requests from eu-west -> eu-central fallback lane (latency + cost tradeoff); 3) enable canary of economy-quantized variant in eu-central for compatibility. anyone object?

jordan (prod-eng): +1. we should also temporarily disable prefetching in that tier (it increases backend load on these models).

leo (infra): I can push the ratecap change. command: `rbctl policy update --region eu-west --tier economy --qps 120 --reason "emergency cap: spike"`

anita (sre): while leo applies, I'll prepare fallback route: `rbctl routing set --from eu-west --to eu-central --tier economy --mode emergency --pct 100` — that will steer all new economy traffic. note: latency to some customers will increase ~120-200ms. post here after rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy started: policy-service (hash ab12c) by leo. ETA ~30s

leo (infra): applied ratecap. `rbctl` returned OK. current qps in eu-west economy dropped ~35% in last 45s.

anita (sre): rolling routing change now. command: `rbctl routing apply --policy region-fallback-eu-2164321000`

deploy-bot: routing change applied, propagated to edge gateways (nodes: 12/12)

maya (oncall): observe: errors down from 18% -> 6% but tail latency still elevated. any model-level throttles?

jordan (prod-eng): I see model throttles for economy-v1 shard 7: high KV cache misses causing repeated recompute. I'm going to flip fallback to quantized variant in eu-central as a quick route.

jordan (prod-eng): `rbctl model set-variant --model economy-v1 --variant economy-quantized --region eu-central --traffic 1.0` — applying

deploy-bot: model variant switch scheduled and completing.

anita (sre): note for postmortem: this is a policy interaction between autoscale burst profile + routing pinning. we need a guard to prevent complete pinning to a single overloaded variant.

eve (support): customers updated: told the three impacted accounts about a mitigation (traffic reroute + temporary rate cap). they asked for an ETA to return to normal. any timeline?

maya (oncall): short term: monitor for 20m after full propagation. if errors <2% and latency trending down we'll relax caps. tentative ETA 30-45m. tell customers we'll follow up in 1 hour.

leo (infra): metrics now: 5xx down to 3.1%, 95p latency eu-west economy at 430ms (from 1.2s). overall qps stable.

anita (sre): starting handoff: I'm taking over primary oncall for incident mitigation and follow-up. maya, please handoff once you've added notes to the incident doc.

maya (oncall): handing off to anita. notes added: https://incidents.redwood.local/2164321000 - includes timeline and commands run. paging remains open.

anita (sre): thanks. I'll coordinate postmortem actions after we verify stability. immediate follow-ups: - add routing pinning guard in policy-engine - add alert for model-variant cache-miss rate - review burst autoscale profile for economy tier

jordan (prod-eng): I'll open a PR to add a soft cap on pinning and a forced spread of connections across compatible variants. link soon.

eve (support): I'll send a brief customer update now and add the ETA note.

anita (sre): closing note: mitigation steps performed: ratecap applied (eu-west economy), emergency routing fallback to eu-central (100% for economy), model-variant switch to quantized in eu-central, prefetch disabled for economy. monitoring in progress.

maya (oncall): thanks team. I'll remain available for any followups. marking incident as 'mitigation in progress' and keeping page open until anita confirms recover and then we do a formal postmortem. :thumbsup:
